technical.summary: Moderate confluence with strong intermediate trend (ADX 36.94, supertrend bullish) but overbought conditions (stoch 88.62, Williams %R), lack of momentum confirmation, and weak long-term structure limit swing entry probability.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (337.6) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 62 days adds event risk to already hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 36.94 confirms strong intermediate trend with supertrend bullish and price above Ichimoku cloud, providing technical structure for swing entry if macro conditions stabilize.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stoch (88.62) with bearish cross, price below 50/200 SMAs, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (337.6), zero fundamental support, and earnings event risk in 62 days create a hostile risk/reward environment that outweighs technical strength.
